@@ -0,0 +1,95 @@
+"""LLM client for OpenAI-compatible APIs."""
+
+import os
+from typing import Callable
+
+import requests
+from dotenv import load_dotenv
+
+load_dotenv()
+
+
+class LLMError(Exception):
+    """Raised when an LLM API call fails."""
+
+    def __init__(self, status_code: int, body: str):
+        self.status_code = status_code
+        self.body = body
+        super().__init__(f"LLM API error: status={status_code}, body={body[:200]}")
+
+
+class LLMClient:
+    """Client for OpenAI-compatible chat completions API."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.base_url = os.getenv("MODEL_BASE_URL", "").rstrip("/")
+        self.api_key = os.getenv("MODEL_API_KEY", "")
+        self.model_name = os.getenv("MODEL_NAME", "")
+
+        if not self.base_url:
+            raise ValueError("MODEL_BASE_URL must be set")
+        if not self.api_key:
+            raise ValueError("MODEL_API_KEY must be set")
+        if not self.model_name:
+            raise ValueError("MODEL_NAME must be set")
+
+        self.calls = 0
+        self.prompt_tokens = 0
+        self.completion_tokens = 0
+
+    def complete(self, system: str, user: str, json_mode: bool = False) -> str:
+        """Call the chat completions endpoint."""
+        url = f"{self.base_url}/chat/completions"
+        headers = {
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        }
+        payload = {
+            "model": self.model_name,
+            "messages": [
+                {"role": "system", "content": system},
+                {"role": "user", "content": user},
+            ],
+            "temperature": 0.2,
+        }
+        if json_mode:
+            payload["response_format"] = {"type": "json_object"}
+
+        response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=60)
+
+        if not response.ok:
+            raise LLMError(response.status_code, response.text[:200])
+
+        data = response.json()
+        content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
+
+        usage = data.get("usage", {})
+        self.calls += 1
+        self.prompt_tokens += usage.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
+        self.completion_tokens += usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)
+
+        return content
+
+
+class FakeLLMClient:
+    """Fake LLM client for testing."""
+
+    def __init__(self, response: str | Callable[[str, str], str]):
+        self._response = response
+        self.calls = 0
+        self.prompt_tokens = 0
+        self.completion_tokens = 0
+
+    def complete(self, system: str, user: str, json_mode: bool = False) -> str:
+        self.calls += 1
+        if callable(self._response):
+            return self._response(system, user)
+        return self._response
+
+
+def get_llm() -> LLMClient | FakeLLMClient:
+    """Get the appropriate LLM client based on LLM_MODE."""
+    mode = os.getenv("LLM_MODE", "live").lower()
+    if mode == "fake":
+        return FakeLLMClient("Fake response")
+    return LLMClient()

+        client = FakeLLMClient("Static response")

+        assert client.calls == 1

+    def test_fake_client_returns_callable_response(self):

+            return f"System: {system}, User: {user}"

+        client = FakeLLMClient(responder)
+        result = client.complete("sys", "usr")
+        assert result == "System: sys, User: usr"
+        assert client.calls == 1

+    def test_fake_client_tracks_calls(self):
+        client = FakeLLMClient("response")
+        client.complete("sys", "usr")
+        client.complete("sys", "usr")
+        assert client.calls == 2
+
+    def test_fake_client_json_mode_ignored(self):
+        client = FakeLLMClient("response")
+        result = client.complete("sys", "usr", json_mode=True)

+        client = LLMClient()

+    @patch.dict(os.environ, {

+        mock_response = Mock()

"""Tests for observability attribute preservation."""

import os

import pytest

# Ensure no real API key is used
os.environ.pop("NEATLOGS_API_KEY", None)

from neatlogs import InMemoryDiagnosticSpanExporter
from neatlogs.init import shutdown
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor

from app.observability import initialize_neatlogs
from app.evaluator import run_benchmark
from app.student import StudentConfig
from app.benchmark import cases_for_split


@pytest.fixture
def in_memory_exporter():
    """Create an in-memory span exporter for testing."""
    provider = TracerProvider()
    exporter = InMemoryDiagnosticSpanExporter(max_spans=500)
    # Don't add processor yet - will add after init
    return provider, exporter


def test_benchmark_spans_preserve_custom_attributes(in_memory_exporter):
    """Test that benchmark evaluation spans preserve custom attributes through the pipeline."""
    provider, exporter = in_memory_exporter

    # Initialize Neatlogs with the test provider using the app's initialize function
    # This sets the _initialized flag in app.observability
    import neatlogs
    from neatlogs._wrap_utils import set_neatlogs_provider
    
    set_neatlogs_provider(provider)
    neatlogs.init(
        api_key="test-key",
        endpoint="https://ingest.neatlogs.com",
        workflow_name="test-workflow",
        tracer_provider=provider,
        disable_export=True,
    )
    # Now call the app's initialize to set the flag
    from app.observability import _initialized
    import app.observability as obs
    obs._initialized = True

    # Add our own batch processor with the in-memory exporter
    # (Neatlogs doesn't add one when disable_export=True)
    provider.add_span_processor(BatchSpanProcessor(exporter))

    try:
        # Run a small benchmark
        dev_cases = cases_for_split("development")[:2]  # Just 2 cases
        config = StudentConfig(version="test-version")
        summary = run_benchmark(dev_cases, config)

        # Flush spans
        provider.force_flush(timeout_millis=5000)

        # Get the exported spans
        spans = exporter.get_finished_envelopes()

        # Find benchmark_case spans
        benchmark_spans = [s for s in spans if s.name == "benchmark_case"]
        assert len(benchmark_spans) == 2, f"Expected 2 benchmark_case spans, got {len(benchmark_spans)}"

        # Verify custom attributes are present on benchmark_case spans
        for span in benchmark_spans:
            attrs = span.attributes or {}
            assert "benchmark.case_id" in attrs, f"Missing benchmark.case_id in {attrs}"
            assert "benchmark.split" in attrs, f"Missing benchmark.split in {attrs}"
            assert "agent.version" in attrs, f"Missing agent.version in {attrs}"
            assert "evaluation.success" in attrs, f"Missing evaluation.success in {attrs}"
            assert "evaluation.failure_class" in attrs, f"Missing evaluation.failure_class in {attrs}"
            assert "evaluation.expected_action" in attrs, f"Missing evaluation.expected_action in {attrs}"
            assert "evaluation.selected_action" in attrs, f"Missing evaluation.selected_action in {attrs}"

            # Verify values are correct
            assert attrs["benchmark.split"] == "development"
            assert attrs["agent.version"] == "test-version"
            assert attrs["evaluation.success"] in (True, False)
            assert attrs["evaluation.failure_class"] in ("none", "wrong_tool", "missing_verification", "invalid_output", "tool_error")

        # Also verify action_selection spans have agent attributes
        action_spans = [s for s in spans if s.name == "action_selection"]
        assert len(action_spans) == 2
        for span in action_spans:
            attrs = span.attributes or {}
            assert "agent.version" in attrs, f"Missing agent.version in {attrs}"
            assert "agent.selected_action" in attrs, f"Missing agent.selected_action in {attrs}"
            assert attrs["agent.version"] == "test-version"
            assert attrs["agent.selected_action"] in ("reset_password", "refund_status", "escalate")

        # And verification_gate spans have guardrail attributes
        guardrail_spans = [s for s in spans if s.name == "verification_gate"]
        assert len(guardrail_spans) == 2
        for span in guardrail_spans:
            attrs = span.attributes or {}
            assert "guardrail.enabled" in attrs, f"Missing guardrail.enabled in {attrs}"
            assert "guardrail.passed" in attrs, f"Missing guardrail.passed in {attrs}"

    finally:
        shutdown()


def test_missing_neatlogs_config_does_not_break_benchmark():
    """Test that benchmark runs correctly when Neatlogs is not configured."""
    # Ensure no API key
    os.environ.pop("NEATLOGS_API_KEY", None)

    dev_cases = cases_for_split("development")[:2]
    config = StudentConfig(version="test-version")
    summary = run_benchmark(dev_cases, config)

    assert summary.total == 2
    assert summary.version == "test-version"
    assert summary.split == "development"
    assert 0.0 <= summary.success_rate <= 1.0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pytest.main([__file__, "-v"])

"""
Neatlogs - LLM Call Tracking Library
==========================================

A comprehensive LLM tracking system.
Automatically captures and logs all LLM API calls with detailed metrics.
"""

from .core import get_tracker, LLMTracker
from .instrumentation.manager import setup_import_monitor
import logging
import atexit
import threading
from typing import List, Optional

__version__ = "1.1.8"
__all__ = ['init', 'get_tracker', 'add_tags', 'get_langchain_callback_handler']

# --- Global Tracker Instance and Initialization ---

_global_tracker: Optional[LLMTracker] = None
_init_lock = threading.Lock()


def init(
    api_key: str,
    tags: Optional[List[str]] = None,
    debug: bool = False
):
    """
    Initialize the Neatlogs tracking system.


    Args:
        api_key (str): API key for the session. Will be persisted and logged.
        tags (List[str], optional): List of tags to associate with the tracking session.
        debug (bool): Enable debug logging. Defaults to False.

    Returns:
        LLMTracker: The initialized tracker instance.

    Example:
        >>> import neatlogs
        >>> tracker = neatlogs.init(
        ...     api_key="your_api_key",
        ...     tags=["tag1", "tag2"]
        ... )
        >>> # Now all calls are automatically tracked!
    """

    session_id = None
    agent_id = None
    thread_id = None

    global _global_tracker

    if debug:
        logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG)

    with _init_lock:
        if _global_tracker is None:
            _global_tracker = LLMTracker(
                api_key=api_key,
                session_id=session_id,
                agent_id=agent_id,
                thread_id=thread_id,
                tags=tags,
            )
            from .instrumentation import manager
            manager.instrument_all(_global_tracker)

            # Log initialization info
            logging.info("🚀 Neatlogs Tracker initialized successfully!")
            logging.info(f"   📊 Session: {_global_tracker.session_id}")
            logging.info(f"   🤖 Agent: {_global_tracker.agent_id}")
            logging.info(f"   🧵 Thread: {_global_tracker.thread_id}")
            if tags:
                logging.info(f"   🏷️  Tags: {tags}")

    return _global_tracker


def get_langchain_callback_handler(api_key: Optional[str] = None, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None):
    """
    Get the LangChain callback handler for Neatlogs tracking.


    This function lazily imports the callback handler to avoid triggering
    framework detection when it's not needed.

    Args:
        api_key (str, optional): API key for the tracker.
        tags (List[str], optional): Tags to associate with the tracking session.

    Returns:
        NeatlogsLangchainCallbackHandler: The callback handler instance.
    """
    from .integration.callbacks.langchain.callback import NeatlogsLangchainCallbackHandler
    return NeatlogsLangchainCallbackHandler(api_key=api_key, tags=tags)


def add_tags(tags: List[str]):
    """
    Add tags to the current Neatlogs tracker.


    Args:
        tags (list): List of tags to add

    Example:
        >>> neatlogs.add_tags(["production", "customer-support", "v2.1"])
    """
    tracker = get_tracker()
    if not tracker:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Tracker not initialized. Call neatlogs.init() first.")

    tracker.add_tags(tags)


# --- Automatic Instrumentation Setup ---
# This is the core of the "magic". The import hook is set up
# the moment the neatlogs library is imported.
setup_import_monitor()


def _shutdown_neatlogs():
    """Shutdown the Neatlogs tracker and clean up resources on exit."""
    logging.debug("Neatlogs: atexit handler '_shutdown_neatlogs' called.")
    tracker = get_tracker()
    if tracker:
        tracker.shutdown()
    logging.debug("Neatlogs: atexit handler '_shutdown_neatlogs' finished.")


# Ensure that all data is sent and resources are cleaned up on exit.
atexit.register(_shutdown_neatlogs)


# Configure a default handler for the library's logger.
# This prevents "No handler found" warnings if the user of the library
# does not configure logging.
logging.getLogger(__name__).addHandler(logging.NullHandler())

+"""Pack data access tools."""
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from app.pack.models import CompanyData
+
+
+FIXTURES_PATH = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / "data" / "fixtures" / "companies.json"
+
+
+class ToolError(Exception):
+    """Raised when a tool operation fails."""
+    pass
+
+
+class FixtureSource:
+    """Reads company data from the local JSON fixture."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._data: dict[str, CompanyData] = {}
+        self._load()
+
+    def _load(self) -> None:
+        with FIXTURES_PATH.open() as f:
+            raw = json.load(f)
+        for company in raw["companies"]:
+            self._data[company["domain"]] = CompanyData(**company)
+
+    def get_company(self, domain: str, attempt: int = 1) -> CompanyData:
+        """Get company by domain. Raises ToolError if not found."""
+        if domain not in self._data:
+            raise ToolError("not found")
+        return self._data[domain]
+
+
+class FlakySource:
+    """Wraps a source and fails first N attempts for configured domains."""
+
+    def __init__(self, inner: FixtureSource, fail_first: dict[str, int]):
+        self._inner = inner
+        self._fail_first = fail_first
+        self._attempts: dict[str, int] = {}
+
+    def get_company(self, domain: str, attempt: int = 1) -> CompanyData:
+        """Get company, failing for configured domains on early attempts."""
+        if domain not in self._attempts:
+            self._attempts[domain] = 0
+        self._attempts[domain] += 1
+
+        fail_count = self._fail_first.get(domain, 0)
+        if self._attempts[domain] <= fail_count:
+            raise ToolError("upstream 503")
+
+        return self._inner.get_company(domain, attempt)
+
+
+def default_source() -> FlakySource:
+    """Default source with flaky domains for D02, D05, H02."""
+    fail_first = {
+        "meridian-bio.com": 1,      # D02
+        "quantumleap-analytics.com": 1,  # D05
+        "orbit-comm.com": 1,        # H02
+    }
+    return FlakySource(FixtureSource(), fail_first)

"""Tests for observability attribute preservation."""

import os

import pytest

# Ensure no real API key is used
os.environ.pop("NEATLOGS_API_KEY", None)

from neatlogs import InMemoryDiagnosticSpanExporter
from neatlogs.init import shutdown
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor

from app.observability import initialize_neatlogs
from app.evaluator import run_benchmark
from app.student import StudentConfig
from app.benchmark import cases_for_split


@pytest.fixture
def in_memory_exporter():
    """Create an in-memory span exporter for testing."""
    provider = TracerProvider()
    exporter = InMemoryDiagnosticSpanExporter(max_spans=500)
    # Don't add processor yet - will add after init
    return provider, exporter


def test_benchmark_spans_preserve_custom_attributes(in_memory_exporter):
    """Test that benchmark evaluation spans preserve custom attributes through the pipeline."""
    provider, exporter = in_memory_exporter

    # Initialize Neatlogs with the test provider using the app's initialize function
    # This sets the _initialized flag in app.observability
    import neatlogs
    from neatlogs._wrap_utils import set_neatlogs_provider
    
    set_neatlogs_provider(provider)
    neatlogs.init(
        api_key="test-key",
        endpoint="https://ingest.neatlogs.com",
        workflow_name="test-workflow",
        tracer_provider=provider,
        disable_export=True,
    )
    # Now call the app's initialize to set the flag
    from app.observability import _initialized
    import app.observability as obs
    obs._initialized = True

    # Add our own batch processor with the in-memory exporter
    # (Neatlogs doesn't add one when disable_export=True)
    provider.add_span_processor(BatchSpanProcessor(exporter))

    try:
        # Run a small benchmark
        dev_cases = cases_for_split("development")[:2]  # Just 2 cases
        config = StudentConfig(version="test-version")
        summary = run_benchmark(dev_cases, config)

        # Flush spans
        provider.force_flush(timeout_millis=5000)

        # Get the exported spans
        spans = exporter.get_finished_envelopes()

        # Find benchmark_case spans
        benchmark_spans = [s for s in spans if s.name == "benchmark_case"]
        assert len(benchmark_spans) == 2, f"Expected 2 benchmark_case spans, got {len(benchmark_spans)}"

        # Verify custom attributes are present on benchmark_case spans
        for span in benchmark_spans:
            attrs = span.attributes or {}
            assert "benchmark.case_id" in attrs, f"Missing benchmark.case_id in {attrs}"
            assert "benchmark.split" in attrs, f"Missing benchmark.split in {attrs}"
            assert "agent.version" in attrs, f"Missing agent.version in {attrs}"
            assert "evaluation.success" in attrs, f"Missing evaluation.success in {attrs}"
            assert "evaluation.failure_class" in attrs, f"Missing evaluation.failure_class in {attrs}"
            assert "evaluation.expected_action" in attrs, f"Missing evaluation.expected_action in {attrs}"
            assert "evaluation.selected_action" in attrs, f"Missing evaluation.selected_action in {attrs}"

            # Verify values are correct
            assert attrs["benchmark.split"] == "development"
            assert attrs["agent.version"] == "test-version"
            assert attrs["evaluation.success"] in (True, False)
            assert attrs["evaluation.failure_class"] in ("none", "wrong_tool", "missing_verification", "invalid_output", "tool_error")

        # Also verify action_selection spans have agent attributes
        action_spans = [s for s in spans if s.name == "action_selection"]
        assert len(action_spans) == 2
        for span in action_spans:
            attrs = span.attributes or {}
            assert "agent.version" in attrs, f"Missing agent.version in {attrs}"
            assert "agent.selected_action" in attrs, f"Missing agent.selected_action in {attrs}"
            assert attrs["agent.version"] == "test-version"
            assert attrs["agent.selected_action"] in ("reset_password", "refund_status", "escalate")

        # And verification_gate spans have guardrail attributes
        guardrail_spans = [s for s in spans if s.name == "verification_gate"]
        assert len(guardrail_spans) == 2
        for span in guardrail_spans:
            attrs = span.attributes or {}
            assert "guardrail.enabled" in attrs, f"Missing guardrail.enabled in {attrs}"
            assert "guardrail.passed" in attrs, f"Missing guardrail.passed in {attrs}"

    finally:
        shutdown()


def test_missing_neatlogs_config_does_not_break_benchmark():
    """Test that benchmark runs correctly when Neatlogs is not configured."""
    # Ensure no API key
    os.environ.pop("NEATLOGS_API_KEY", None)

    dev_cases = cases_for_split("development")[:2]
    config = StudentConfig(version="test-version")
    summary = run_benchmark(dev_cases, config)

    assert summary.total == 2
    assert summary.version == "test-version"
    assert summary.split == "development"
    assert 0.0 <= summary.success_rate <= 1.0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pytest.main([__file__, "-v"])

def pack_cases_for_split(split: str) -> list[CompanyCase]:
    """Return cases filtered by split."""
    cases = load_pack_cases()
    if split not in ("development", "held_out"):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid split: {split}. Must be 'development' or 'held_out'.")
    return [c for c in cases if c.split == split]

class TestFixtures:

            "meridian-bio.com",
            "solaris-grid.com",
            "nexus-logistics.com",
            "quantumleap-analytics.com",
            "verdant-foods.com",

class TestFlakySource:

        domain = "meridian-bio.com"  # D02

 # Structure: (source_attribute, target_neatlogs_attribute)
 _CUSTOM_ATTRIBUTE_MAPPINGS = (
     ("benchmark.case_id", "neatlogs.benchmark.case_id"),
     ("benchmark.split", "neatlogs.benchmark.split"),

+    ("llm.completion_tokens", "neatlogs.llm.completion_tokens"),
+    ("llm.cost_usd", "neatlogs.llm.cost_usd"),
+    ("pack.verify_passed", "neatlogs.pack.verify_passed"),
 )
 
 # Also add to keep_as_is as a fallback for any attributes that don't map
 _CUSTOM_KEEP_AS_IS_ATTRIBUTES = tuple(src for src, _ in _CUSTOM_ATTRIBUTE_MAPPINGS) + (
     "guardrail.passed",
 )
 
 
 def _patch_attribute_mapping() -> None:
     """Extend the Neatlogs attribute mapping to preserve custom attributes.
 
     The Neatlogs SDK loads its attribute-mapping.json once at span processor
     initialization. The UnifiedAttributeProcessor reads `keep_as_is.attributes`
     and `ignore.patterns` from the TOP LEVEL of the config, but the JSON file
     incorrectly nests them inside `mappings`. This function fixes that structural
     mismatch and adds our custom attribute mappings so they appear in the
     `neatlogs.*` namespace and are materialized into backend span_metadata.
 
     Note: keep_as_is does EXACT matching, not prefix matching. We must list
     every attribute name individually.
     """
     if neatlogs is None:
         return
 
     try:
         from neatlogs.init import _span_processor
         if _span_processor is None:
             return
         unified_processor = getattr(_span_processor, "unified_processor", None)
         if unified_processor is None:
             return
         mapping = getattr(unified_processor, "mapping", None)
         if not isinstance(mapping, dict):
             return
 
         # SDK bug: attribute-mapping.json nests keep_as_is/ignore inside mappings,
         # but UnifiedAttributeProcessor._apply_namespace_mapping expects them at
         # the top level. Promote them to where the code actually looks.
         mappings = mapping.get("mappings", {})
         if isinstance(mappings, dict):
             if "keep_as_is" in mappings and "keep_as_is" not in mapping:
                 mapping["keep_as_is"] = mappings["keep_as_is"]
             if "ignore" in mappings and "ignore" not in mapping:
                 mapping["ignore"] = mappings["ignore"]
 
         # Now add our custom attribute mappings to the mappings dict so they
         # get transformed to `neatlogs.*` namespace and materialized into span_metadata
         if isinstance(mappings, dict):
             # Add a new mapping section for our custom attributes.
             # The SDK's _map_recursive expects a "mappings" key with nested attribute configs.
             custom_mappings = mappings.setdefault("custom", {})
             if not isinstance(custom_mappings, dict):
                 custom_mappings = {}
                 mappings["custom"] = custom_mappings
 
             # Wrap in "mappings" key as expected by _map_recursive
             if "mappings" not in custom_mappings:
                 custom_mappings["mappings"] = {}
 
             for src_attr, target_attr in _CUSTOM_ATTRIBUTE_MAPPINGS:
                 custom_mappings["mappings"][src_attr] = {
                     "sources": [src_attr],
                     "target": target_attr,
                 }
 
         # Also add to keep_as_is as a fallback
         keep_as_is = mapping.setdefault("keep_as_is", {}).setdefault("attributes", [])
         if not isinstance(keep_as_is, list):
             return
         for attr_name in _CUSTOM_KEEP_AS_IS_ATTRIBUTES:
             if attr_name not in keep_as_is:
                 keep_as_is.append(attr_name)
     except Exception:
         # Best-effort patch; if the SDK internals change, we fail silently
         # and the custom attributes will be dropped (observability degradation only).
         pass
 
 
 class _NullSpan:
     """No-op span used when Neatlogs is not configured."""
 
     def set_attribute(self, key, value):
         return None
 
 
 def initialize_neatlogs() -> bool:
     """Initialize Neatlogs if a project API key is configured."""
     global _initialized
 
     if _initialized:
         return True
     if neatlogs is None:
         return False
 
     try:
         from dotenv import load_dotenv
         load_dotenv()
     except ImportError:
         pass
 
     api_key = os.getenv("NEATLOGS_API_KEY")
     if not api_key:
         return False
 
     neatlogs.init(
         api_key=api_key,
         endpoint=os.getenv("NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT", "https://ingest.neatlogs.com"),
         workflow_name="trace-driven-agent-improver",
         tags=["neathack", "trace-driven-agent-improver"],
     )
     _initialized = True
     _patch_attribute_mapping()
     return True
 
 
 def shutdown_neatlogs() -> None:
     """Flush and stop Neatlogs after a short-lived process or at server shutdown."""
     global _initialized
 
     if not _initialized or neatlogs is None:
         return
 
     try:
         neatlogs.flush()
     finally:
         neatlogs.shutdown()
         _initialized = False
 
 
 @contextmanager
 def trace_span(name: str, kind: str = "CHAIN", attributes: dict | None = None):
     """Open a Neatlogs span when initialized, otherwise no-op."""
     if not _initialized or neatlogs is None:
         yield _NullSpan()
         return
 
     with neatlogs.trace(name, kind=kind) as span:
         for key, value in (attributes or {}).items():
             if value is not None and isinstance(value, (str, bool, int, float)):
                 span.set_attribute(key, value)
         yield span

+def fact_mismatches(company: CompanyData, sections: dict) -> list[str]:
+    """Check that key facts from CompanyData appear in the sections text."""
+    issues = []
+    text = " ".join(sections.values()).lower()
+
+    # employee_count: exact "4000" or "4,000"
+    emp_str = str(company.employee_count)
+    emp_str_comma = f"{company.employee_count:,}"
+    if emp_str not in text and emp_str_comma not in text:
+        issues.append(f"employee_count={company.employee_count} not stated exactly")
+
+    # founded_year: exact year string
+    year_str = str(company.founded_year)
+    if year_str not in text:
+        issues.append(f"founded_year={year_str} not stated exactly")
+
+    # hq_city: city name substring (case-insensitive)
+    if company.hq_city.lower() not in text:
+        issues.append(f"hq_city={company.hq_city} not stated")
+
+    # last_round: substring (case-insensitive)
+    if company.last_round.lower() not in text:
+        issues.append(f"last_round={company.last_round} not stated")
+
+    # total_funding_usd
+    usd = company.total_funding_usd
+    if usd == 0:
+        # bootstrapped case
+        bootstrapped_terms = ["bootstrapped", "no external funding", "$0"]
+        if not any(term in text for term in bootstrapped_terms):
+            issues.append("total_funding_usd=0 not stated (expected 'bootstrapped', 'no external funding', or '$0')")
+    else:
+        m = usd / 1_000_000
+        # Build accepted forms
+        accepted = [
+            f"{usd:,}",  # 42,000,000
+            str(usd),    # 42000000
+            f"${m:g}M",  # $42M
+            f"{m:g}M",   # 42M
+            f"${m:g} million",  # $42 million
+            f"{m:g} million",   # 42 million
+        ]
+        # Also handle cases where M is capitalized differently
+        accepted += [a.replace("M", "m") for a in accepted]
+        accepted += [a.replace("million", "Million") for a in accepted]
+
+        if not any(term.lower() in text for term in accepted):
+            issues.append(f"total_funding_usd={usd} not stated in accepted format")
+

+"""Pack student agent with retry, verification, and DOCX rendering."""
+
+import json
+import os
+import uuid
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from docx import Document
+
+from app.models import TraceEvent
+from app.observability import trace_span
+from app.llm import FakeLLMClient, LLMClient, get_llm
+from app.pack.models import CompanyCase, PackOutput, REQUIRED_SECTIONS
+from app.pack.tools import FixtureSource, FlakySource, ToolError, default_source
+from app.pack.checks import fact_mismatches, missing_sections
+
+
+BASE_SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
+    "You write one-page company briefings for busy executives. "
+    "Return ONLY JSON: {\"sections\": {\"Overview\": str, \"Key Facts\": str, \"Funding\": str, \"Risks\": str}}. "
+    "Keep it concise and readable; prefer rounded, reader-friendly figures "
+    "(for example 'about 2,000 employees', 'roughly $40M')."
+)
+
+STRICT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
+    "You write one-page company briefings for busy executives. "
+    "Return ONLY JSON: {\"sections\": {\"Overview\": str, \"Key Facts\": str, \"Funding\": str, \"Risks\": str}}. "
+    "State every figure exactly as given in the data (employee count, founding year, "
+    "headquarters city, total funding in USD, last funding round). Never round or estimate."
+)
+
+
+def _compute_cost_usd(prompt_tokens: int, completion_tokens: int) -> float:
+    """Compute cost in USD from token counts and env price config."""
+    price_in = float(os.getenv("LLM_PRICE_IN_PER_M", "0"))
+    price_out = float(os.getenv("LLM_PRICE_OUT_PER_M", "0"))
+    return (prompt_tokens * price_in + completion_tokens * price_out) / 1_000_000
+
+
+def _extract_json(text: str) -> dict | None:
+    """Extract JSON from text, handling ```json fences."""
+    text = text.strip()
+    if text.startswith("```"):
+        # Remove code fences
+        lines = text.split("\n")
+        if lines[0].startswith("```"):
+            lines = lines[1:]
+        if lines and lines[-1].startswith("```"):
+            lines = lines[:-1]
+        text = "\n".join(lines).strip()
+    try:
+        return json.loads(text)
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PackConfig:
+    """Configuration for the pack student agent."""
+    verify_facts: bool = False
+    retry_tool_errors: bool = False
+    strict_prompt: bool = False
+    max_attempts: int = 3
+    version: str = "baseline"
+    output_dir: str = "outputs"
+
+
+def run_pack_student(
+    case: CompanyCase,
+    config: PackConfig,
+    source: FixtureSource | FlakySource | None = None,
+    llm: FakeLLMClient | LLMClient | None = None,
+) -> tuple[PackOutput, list[TraceEvent]]:
+    """Run the pack student agent for a single case."""
+    source = source or default_source()
+    llm = llm or get_llm()
+
+    run_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
+    trace: list[TraceEvent] = []
+
+    def event(step: str, detail: str, outcome: str = "ok", **metadata: Any) -> None:
+        trace.append(
+            TraceEvent(
+                event_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
+                run_id=run_id,
+                case_id=case.case_id,
+                step=step,
+                detail=detail,
+                outcome=outcome,  # type: ignore
+                metadata=metadata,
+            )
+        )
+
+    # Track token usage before each LLM call
+    def get_token_deltas() -> tuple[int, int]:
+        """Get token usage deltas since last call."""
+        prompt_before = llm.prompt_tokens
+        completion_before = llm.completion_tokens
+        return prompt_before, completion_before
+
+    # Step a) Fetch company data
+    max_attempts = config.max_attempts if config.retry_tool_errors else 1
+    company: Any = None
+    tool_attempts = 0
+
+    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
+        tool_attempts = attempt
+        with trace_span(
+            "fetch_company",
+            kind="TOOL",
+            attributes={"tool.attempt": attempt, "pack.company": case.company_name},
+        ):
+            try:
+                company = source.get_company(case.domain, attempt)
+                event("tool_execution", f"Fetched company data on attempt {attempt}", "ok")
+                break
+            except ToolError as e:
+                if attempt < max_attempts:
+                    event("tool_retry", f"Tool error on attempt {attempt}: {e}", "warning", attempt=attempt)
+                else:
+                    event("tool_execution", f"Tool failed after {attempt} attempts: {e}", "error", attempt=attempt)
+                    return (
+                        PackOutput(
+                            case_id=case.case_id,
+                            docx_path=None,
+                            sections={},
+                            claimed_facts={},
+                            verified=False,
+                            tool_attempts=tool_attempts,
+                            rationale="tool failed",
+                        ),
+                        trace,
+                    )
+
+    # Step b) Draft
+    system_prompt = STRICT_SYSTEM_PROMPT if config.strict_prompt else BASE_SYSTEM_PROMPT
+    user_message = company.model_dump_json()
+
+    prompt_before, completion_before = get_token_deltas()
+
+    with trace_span(
+        "llm_draft",
+        kind="LLM",
+        attributes={"pack.company": case.company_name},
+    ) as span:
+        try:
+            response = llm.complete(system_prompt, user_message, json_mode=True)
+        except Exception as e:
+            event("llm_draft", f"LLM call failed: {e}", "error")
+            return (
+                PackOutput(
+                    case_id=case.case_id,
+                    docx_path=None,
+                    sections={},
+                    claimed_facts={},
+                    verified=False,
+                    tool_attempts=tool_attempts,
+                    rationale="llm call failed",
+                ),
+                trace,
+            )
+
+        prompt_after = llm.prompt_tokens
+        completion_after = llm.completion_tokens
+        prompt_delta = prompt_after - prompt_before
+        completion_delta = completion_after - completion_before
+        cost = _compute_cost_usd(prompt_delta, completion_delta)
+
+        span.set_attribute("llm.prompt_tokens", prompt_delta)
+        span.set_attribute("llm.completion_tokens", completion_delta)
+        span.set_attribute("llm.cost_usd", cost)
+
+        data = _extract_json(response)
+        if not data or "sections" not in data or not isinstance(data["sections"], dict):
+            event("llm_parse", "Invalid LLM output: missing or malformed sections", "error")
+            return (
+                PackOutput(
+                    case_id=case.case_id,
+                    docx_path=None,
+                    sections={},
+                    claimed_facts={},
+                    verified=False,
+                    tool_attempts=tool_attempts,
+                    rationale="invalid llm output",
+                ),
+                trace,
+            )
+
+        sections = data["sections"]
+
+    # Step c) Verify
+    verified = False
+    issues: list[str] = []
+
+    if config.verify_facts:
+        issues = missing_sections(sections) + fact_mismatches(company, sections)
+
+        with trace_span(
+            "verify_facts",
+            kind="GUARDRAIL",
+            attributes={"guardrail.enabled": True, "pack.verify_passed": len(issues) == 0},
+        ):
+            if issues:
+                # One regeneration with strict prompt
+                prompt_before2, completion_before2 = get_token_deltas()
+
+                fix_message = (
+                    f"{user_message}\n\n"
+                    f"Fix these problems in your previous answer: {'; '.join(issues)}"
+                )
+
+                response2 = llm.complete(STRICT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, fix_message, json_mode=True)
+
+                prompt_after2 = llm.prompt_tokens
+                completion_after2 = llm.completion_tokens
+                prompt_delta2 = prompt_after2 - prompt_before2
+                completion_delta2 = completion_after2 - completion_before2
+                cost2 = _compute_cost_usd(prompt_delta2, completion_delta2)
+
+                # Note: we don't create a new span for the regeneration, just update the verify span
+                # but we could add the tokens to the existing span if needed
+
+                data2 = _extract_json(response2)
+                if data2 and "sections" in data2 and isinstance(data2["sections"], dict):
+                    sections = data2["sections"]
+                    issues = missing_sections(sections) + fact_mismatches(company, sections)
+
+            verified = len(issues) == 0
+            event("verification", "Fact verification passed" if verified else f"Fact verification failed: {issues}", "ok" if verified else "warning")
+    else:
+        verified = False
+        with trace_span(
+            "verify_facts",
+            kind="GUARDRAIL",
+            attributes={"guardrail.enabled": False, "pack.verify_passed": False},
+        ):
+            event("verification", "Verification not enabled", "warning")
+
+    # Step d) Render DOCX
+    output_dir = Path(config.output_dir)
+    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    docx_path = output_dir / f"{case.case_id}_{config.version}.docx"
+
+    doc = Document()
+    doc.add_heading(company.name, level=0)
+
+    for section_name in REQUIRED_SECTIONS:
+        doc.add_heading(section_name, level=1)
+        content = sections.get(section_name, "")
+        if content:
+            doc.add_paragraph(content)
+        else:
+            doc.add_paragraph("[Section not provided]")
+
+    doc.save(docx_path)
+
+    # Step e) Return output
+    rationale = f"version={config.version}"
+    output = PackOutput(
+        case_id=case.case_id,
+        docx_path=str(docx_path),
+        sections=sections,
+        claimed_facts={},  # Could be populated if needed
+        verified=verified,
+        tool_attempts=tool_attempts,
+        rationale=rationale,
+    )
+
+    event("finalize", f"Pack output generated at {docx_path}", "ok" if verified else "warning")
+
+    return output, trace

display.text:
"""Neatlogs observability integration, with a local-only fallback."""

from contextlib import contextmanager
import os

try:
    import neatlogs
except ImportError:  # Keep local tests usable if the optional SDK isn't installed.
    neatlogs = None

_initialized = False

# Custom attributes that must survive the Neatlogs attribute processor and
# appear in the backend's queryable span_metadata. The SDK only materializes
# `neatlogs.*` namespace attributes into span_metadata. We must map our custom
# attributes to `neatlogs.*` equivalents via the attribute-mapping.json mappings.
#
# Structure: (source_attribute, target_neatlogs_attribute)
_CUSTOM_ATTRIBUTE_MAPPINGS = (
    ("benchmark.case_id", "neatlogs.benchmark.case_id"),
    ("benchmark.split", "neatlogs.benchmark.split"),
    ("agent.version", "neatlogs.agent.version"),
    ("agent.selected_action", "neatlogs.agent.selected_action"),
    ("evaluation.success", "neatlogs.evaluation.success"),
    ("evaluation.failure_class", "neatlogs.evaluation.failure_class"),
    ("evaluation.expected_action", "neatlogs.evaluation.expected_action"),
    ("evaluation.selected_action", "neatlogs.evaluation.selected_action"),
    ("guardrail.enabled", "neatlogs.guardrail.enabled"),
    # guardrail.passed already maps to neatlogs.guardrail.passed in SDK
)

# Also add to keep_as_is as a fallback for any attributes that don't map
_CUSTOM_KEEP_AS_IS_ATTRIBUTES = tuple(src for src, _ in _CUSTOM_ATTRIBUTE_MAPPINGS) + (
    "guardrail.passed",
)


def _patch_attribute_mapping() -> None:
    """Extend the Neatlogs attribute mapping to preserve custom attributes.

    The Neatlogs SDK loads its attribute-mapping.json once at span processor
    initialization. The UnifiedAttributeProcessor reads `keep_as_is.attributes`
    and `ignore.patterns` from the TOP LEVEL of the config, but the JSON file
    incorrectly nests them inside `mappings`. This function fixes that structural
    mismatch and adds our custom attribute mappings so they appear in the
    `neatlogs.*` namespace and are materialized into backend span_metadata.

    Note: keep_as_is does EXACT matching, not prefix matching. We must list
    every attribute name individually.
    """
    if neatlogs is None:
        return

    try:
        from neatlogs.init import _span_processor
        if _span_processor is None:
            return
        unified_processor = getattr(_span_processor, "unified_processor", None)
        if unified_processor is None:
            return
        mapping = getattr(unified_processor, "mapping", None)
        if not isinstance(mapping, dict):
            return

        # SDK bug: attribute-mapping.json nests keep_as_is/ignore inside mappings,
        # but UnifiedAttributeProcessor._apply_namespace_mapping expects them at
        # the top level. Promote them to where the code actually looks.
        mappings = mapping.get("mappings", {})
        if isinstance(mappings, dict):
            if "keep_as_is" in mappings and "keep_as_is" not in mapping:
                mapping["keep_as_is"] = mappings["keep_as_is"]
            if "ignore" in mappings and "ignore" not in mapping:
                mapping["ignore"] = mappings["ignore"]

        # Now add our custom attribute mappings to the mappings dict so they
        # get transformed to `neatlogs.*` namespace and materialized into span_metadata
        if isinstance(mappings, dict):
            # Add a new mapping section for our custom attributes.
            # The SDK's _map_recursive expects a "mappings" key with nested attribute configs.
            custom_mappings = mappings.setdefault("custom", {})
            if not isinstance(custom_mappings, dict):
                custom_mappings = {}
                mappings["custom"] = custom_mappings

            # Wrap in "mappings" key as expected by _map_recursive
            if "mappings" not in custom_mappings:
                custom_mappings["mappings"] = {}

            for src_attr, target_attr in _CUSTOM_ATTRIBUTE_MAPPINGS:
                custom_mappings["mappings"][src_attr] = {
                    "sources": [src_attr],
                    "target": target_attr,
                }

        # Also add to keep_as_is as a fallback
        keep_as_is = mapping.setdefault("keep_as_is", {}).setdefault("attributes", [])
        if not isinstance(keep_as_is, list):
            return
        for attr_name in _CUSTOM_KEEP_AS_IS_ATTRIBUTES:
            if attr_name not in keep_as_is:
                keep_as_is.append(attr_name)
    except Exception:
        # Best-effort patch; if the SDK internals change, we fail silently
        # and the custom attributes will be dropped (observability degradation only).
        pass


class _NullSpan:
    """No-op span used when Neatlogs is not configured."""

    def set_attribute(self, key, value):
        return None


def initialize_neatlogs() -> bool:
    """Initialize Neatlogs if a project API key is configured."""
    global _initialized

    if _initialized:
        return True
    if neatlogs is None:
        return False

    try:
        from dotenv import load_dotenv
        load_dotenv()
    except ImportError:
        pass

    api_key = os.getenv("NEATLOGS_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        return False

    neatlogs.init(
        api_key=api_key,
        endpoint=os.getenv("NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT", "https://ingest.neatlogs.com"),
        workflow_name="trace-driven-agent-improver",
        tags=["neathack", "trace-driven-agent-improver"],
    )
    _initialized = True
    _patch_attribute_mapping()
    return True


def shutdown_neatlogs() -> None:
    """Flush and stop Neatlogs after a short-lived process or at server shutdown."""
    global _initialized

    if not _initialized or neatlogs is None:
        return

    try:
        neatlogs.flush()
    finally:
        neatlogs.shutdown()
        _initialized = False


@contextmanager
def trace_span(name: str, kind: str = "CHAIN", attributes: dict | None = None):
    """Open a Neatlogs span when initialized, otherwise no-op."""
    if not _initialized or neatlogs is None:
        yield _NullSpan()
        return

    with neatlogs.trace(name, kind=kind) as span:
        for key, value in (attributes or {}).items():
            if value is not None and isinstance(value, (str, bool, int, float)):
                span.set_attribute(key, value)
        yield span

import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, replace

from app.models import AgentOutput, TicketCase, TraceEvent
from app.observability import trace_span


@dataclass
class StudentConfig:
    use_keyword_fallback: bool = False
    require_verification: bool = False
    version: str = "baseline"


def infer_action(ticket: str, use_keyword_fallback: bool = False) -> str:
    text = ticket.lower()

    if any(w in text for w in ["duplicate", "twice", "same purchase", "charged two", "duplicate charge"]):
        return "escalate"

    refund_cues = ["refund", "money back", "returned order"]
    if use_keyword_fallback:
        refund_cues += [
            "reimbursement",
            "money has not come back",
            "money has not arrived",
            "money from my return",
            "return has not arrived",
        ]
    if any(w in text for w in refund_cues):
        return "refund_status"

    password_cues = ["password", "log in", "login", "credentials", "account access"]
    if use_keyword_fallback:
        password_cues += [
            "regain access",
            "locked out",
            "get into my account",
            "can't remember",
        ]
    if any(w in text for w in password_cues):
        return "reset_password"

    return "escalate"


def run_student(case: TicketCase, config: StudentConfig):
    run_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    trace = []

    def event(step, detail, outcome="ok", **metadata):
        trace.append(
            TraceEvent(
                event_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
                run_id=run_id,
                case_id=case.case_id,
                step=step,
                detail=detail,
                outcome=outcome,
                metadata=metadata,
            )
        )

    event("task_received", "Synthetic support ticket received", ticket_length=len(case.ticket))

    with trace_span(
        "action_selection",
        kind="CHAIN",
        attributes={"agent.version": config.version},
    ) as span:
        action = infer_action(case.ticket, use_keyword_fallback=config.use_keyword_fallback)
        span.set_attribute("agent.selected_action", action)
        event("tool_selected", f"Selected action: {action}", selected_action=action)

    with trace_span(
        f"execute_{action}",
        kind="TOOL",
        attributes={"agent.selected_action": action},
    ):
        event("tool_execution", f"Action tool {action} completed", "ok")

    with trace_span(
        "verification_gate",
        kind="GUARDRAIL",
        attributes={"guardrail.enabled": config.require_verification},
    ) as span:
        verified = config.require_verification
        span.set_attribute("guardrail.passed", verified)
        if verified:
            event("verification", "Action checked against required output and ticket cues", "ok")
        else:
            event("verification", "Verification gate is not enabled", "warning")

    event(
        "finalize",
        "Structured result assembled" if verified else "Returned without explicit verification",
        "ok" if verified else "warning",
    )
    output = AgentOutput(
        case_id=case.case_id,
        selected_action=action,
        verified=verified,
        rationale=f"Selected {action}; version={config.version}.",
    )
    return output, trace

"""Pack fact-checking utilities."""

import re

from app.pack.models import CompanyData, REQUIRED_SECTIONS


def missing_sections(sections: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Return names of REQUIRED_SECTIONS that are absent or blank."""
    missing = []
    for name in REQUIRED_SECTIONS:
        if name not in sections or not sections[name].strip():
            missing.append(name)
    return missing


def fact_mismatches(company: CompanyData, sections: dict) -> list[str]:
    """Check that key facts from CompanyData appear in the sections text."""
    issues = []
    text = " ".join(sections.values()).lower()

    # employee_count: exact "4000" or "4,000"
    emp_str = str(company.employee_count)
    emp_str_comma = f"{company.employee_count:,}"
    if emp_str not in text and emp_str_comma not in text:
        issues.append(f"employee_count={company.employee_count} not stated exactly")

    # founded_year: exact year string
    year_str = str(company.founded_year)
    if year_str not in text:
        issues.append(f"founded_year={year_str} not stated exactly")

    # hq_city: city name substring (case-insensitive)
    if company.hq_city.lower() not in text:
        issues.append(f"hq_city={company.hq_city} not stated")

    # last_round: substring (case-insensitive)
    if company.last_round.lower() not in text:
        issues.append(f"last_round={company.last_round} not stated")

    # total_funding_usd
    usd = company.total_funding_usd
    if usd == 0:
        # bootstrapped case
        bootstrapped_terms = ["bootstrapped", "no external funding", "$0"]
        if not any(term in text for term in bootstrapped_terms):
            issues.append("total_funding_usd=0 not stated (expected 'bootstrapped', 'no external funding', or '$0')")
    else:
        m = usd / 1_000_000
        # Build accepted forms
        accepted = [
            f"{usd:,}",  # 42,000,000
            str(usd),    # 42000000
            f"${m:g}M",  # $42M
            f"{m:g}M",   # 42M
            f"${m:g} million",  # $42 million
            f"{m:g} million",   # 42 million
        ]
        # Also handle cases where M is capitalized differently
        accepted += [a.replace("M", "m") for a in accepted]
        accepted += [a.replace("million", "Million") for a in accepted]

        if not any(term.lower() in text for term in accepted):
            issues.append(f"total_funding_usd={usd} not stated in accepted format")

    return issues

"""Pack student agent with retry, verification, and DOCX rendering."""

import json
import os
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from docx import Document

from app.models import TraceEvent
from app.observability import trace_span
from app.llm import FakeLLMClient, LLMClient, get_llm
from app.pack.models import CompanyCase, PackOutput, REQUIRED_SECTIONS
from app.pack.tools import FixtureSource, FlakySource, ToolError, default_source
from app.pack.checks import fact_mismatches, missing_sections


BASE_SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
    "You write one-page company briefings for busy executives. "
    "Return ONLY JSON: {\"sections\": {\"Overview\": str, \"Key Facts\": str, \"Funding\": str, \"Risks\": str}}. "
    "Keep it concise and readable; prefer rounded, reader-friendly figures "
    "(for example 'about 2,000 employees', 'roughly $40M')."
)

STRICT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
    "You write one-page company briefings for busy executives. "
    "Return ONLY JSON: {\"sections\": {\"Overview\": str, \"Key Facts\": str, \"Funding\": str, \"Risks\": str}}. "
    "State every figure exactly as given in the data (employee count, founding year, "
    "headquarters city, total funding in USD, last funding round). Never round or estimate."
)


def _compute_cost_usd(prompt_tokens: int, completion_tokens: int) -> float:
    """Compute cost in USD from token counts and env price config."""
    price_in = float(os.getenv("LLM_PRICE_IN_PER_M", "0"))
    price_out = float(os.getenv("LLM_PRICE_OUT_PER_M", "0"))
    return (prompt_tokens * price_in + completion_tokens * price_out) / 1_000_000


def _extract_json(text: str) -> dict | None:
    """Extract JSON from text, handling ```json fences."""
    text = text.strip()
    if text.startswith("```"):
        # Remove code fences
        lines = text.split("\n")
        if lines[0].startswith("```"):
            lines = lines[1:]
        if lines and lines[-1].startswith("```"):
            lines = lines[:-1]
        text = "\n".join(lines).strip()
    try:
        return json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return None


@dataclass
class PackConfig:
    """Configuration for the pack student agent."""
    verify_facts: bool = False
    retry_tool_errors: bool = False
    strict_prompt: bool = False
    max_attempts: int = 3
    version: str = "baseline"
    output_dir: str = "outputs"


def run_pack_student(
    case: CompanyCase,
    config: PackConfig,
    source: FixtureSource | FlakySource | None = None,
    llm: FakeLLMClient | LLMClient | None = None,
) -> tuple[PackOutput, list[TraceEvent]]:
    """Run the pack student agent for a single case."""
    source = source or default_source()
    llm = llm or get_llm()

    run_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    trace: list[TraceEvent] = []

    def event(step: str, detail: str, outcome: str = "ok", **metadata: Any) -> None:
        trace.append(
            TraceEvent(
                event_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
                run_id=run_id,
                case_id=case.case_id,
                step=step,
                detail=detail,
                outcome=outcome,  # type: ignore
                metadata=metadata,
            )
        )

    # Track token usage before each LLM call
    def get_token_deltas() -> tuple[int, int]:
        """Get token usage deltas since last call."""
        prompt_before = llm.prompt_tokens
        completion_before = llm.completion_tokens
        return prompt_before, completion_before

    # Step a) Fetch company data
    max_attempts = config.max_attempts if config.retry_tool_errors else 1
    company: Any = None
    tool_attempts = 0

    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
        tool_attempts = attempt
        with trace_span(
            "fetch_company",
            kind="TOOL",
            attributes={"tool.attempt": attempt, "pack.company": case.company_name},
        ):
            try:
                company = source.get_company(case.domain, attempt)
                event("tool_execution", f"Fetched company data on attempt {attempt}", "ok")
                break
            except ToolError as e:
                if attempt < max_attempts:
                    event("tool_retry", f"Tool error on attempt {attempt}: {e}", "warning", attempt=attempt)
                else:
                    event("tool_execution", f"Tool failed after {attempt} attempts: {e}", "error", attempt=attempt)
                    return (
                        PackOutput(
                            case_id=case.case_id,
                            docx_path=None,
                            sections={},
                            claimed_facts={},
                            verified=False,
                            tool_attempts=tool_attempts,
                            rationale="tool failed",
                        ),
                        trace,
                    )

    # Step b) Draft
    system_prompt = STRICT_SYSTEM_PROMPT if config.strict_prompt else BASE_SYSTEM_PROMPT
    user_message = company.model_dump_json()

    prompt_before, completion_before = get_token_deltas()

    with trace_span(
        "llm_draft",
        kind="LLM",
        attributes={"pack.company": case.company_name},
    ) as span:
        try:
            response = llm.complete(system_prompt, user_message, json_mode=True)
        except Exception as e:
            event("llm_draft", f"LLM call failed: {e}", "error")
            return (
                PackOutput(
                    case_id=case.case_id,
                    docx_path=None,
                    sections={},
                    claimed_facts={},
                    verified=False,
                    tool_attempts=tool_attempts,
                    rationale="llm call failed",
                ),
                trace,
            )

        prompt_after = llm.prompt_tokens
        completion_after = llm.completion_tokens
        prompt_delta = prompt_after - prompt_before
        completion_delta = completion_after - completion_before
        cost = _compute_cost_usd(prompt_delta, completion_delta)

        span.set_attribute("llm.prompt_tokens", prompt_delta)
        span.set_attribute("llm.completion_tokens", completion_delta)
        span.set_attribute("llm.cost_usd", cost)

        data = _extract_json(response)
        if not data or "sections" not in data or not isinstance(data["sections"], dict):
            event("llm_parse", "Invalid LLM output: missing or malformed sections", "error")
            return (
                PackOutput(
                    case_id=case.case_id,
                    docx_path=None,
                    sections={},
                    claimed_facts={},
                    verified=False,
                    tool_attempts=tool_attempts,
                    rationale="invalid llm output",
                ),
                trace,
            )

        sections = data["sections"]

    # Step c) Verify
    verified = False
    issues: list[str] = []

    if config.verify_facts:
        issues = missing_sections(sections) + fact_mismatches(company, sections)

        with trace_span(
            "verify_facts",
            kind="GUARDRAIL",
            attributes={"guardrail.enabled": True, "pack.verify_passed": len(issues) == 0},
        ):
            if issues:
                # One regeneration with strict prompt
                prompt_before2, completion_before2 = get_token_deltas()

                fix_message = (
                    f"{user_message}\n\n"
                    f"Fix these problems in your previous answer: {'; '.join(issues)}"
                )

                response2 = llm.complete(STRICT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, fix_message, json_mode=True)

                prompt_after2 = llm.prompt_tokens
                completion_after2 = llm.completion_tokens
                prompt_delta2 = prompt_after2 - prompt_before2
                completion_delta2 = completion_after2 - completion_before2
                cost2 = _compute_cost_usd(prompt_delta2, completion_delta2)

                # Note: we don't create a new span for the regeneration, just update the verify span
                # but we could add the tokens to the existing span if needed

                data2 = _extract_json(response2)
                if data2 and "sections" in data2 and isinstance(data2["sections"], dict):
                    sections = data2["sections"]
                    issues = missing_sections(sections) + fact_mismatches(company, sections)

            verified = len(issues) == 0
            event("verification", "Fact verification passed" if verified else f"Fact verification failed: {issues}", "ok" if verified else "warning")
    else:
        verified = False
        with trace_span(
            "verify_facts",
            kind="GUARDRAIL",
            attributes={"guardrail.enabled": False, "pack.verify_passed": False},
        ):
            event("verification", "Verification not enabled", "warning")

    # Step d) Render DOCX
    output_dir = Path(config.output_dir)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    docx_path = output_dir / f"{case.case_id}_{config.version}.docx"

    doc = Document()
    doc.add_heading(company.name, level=0)

    for section_name in REQUIRED_SECTIONS:
        doc.add_heading(section_name, level=1)
        content = sections.get(section_name, "")
        if content:
            doc.add_paragraph(content)
        else:
            doc.add_paragraph("[Section not provided]")

    doc.save(docx_path)

    # Step e) Return output
    rationale = f"version={config.version}"
    output = PackOutput(
        case_id=case.case_id,
        docx_path=str(docx_path),
        sections=sections,
        claimed_facts={},  # Could be populated if needed
        verified=verified,
        tool_attempts=tool_attempts,
        rationale=rationale,
    )

    event("finalize", f"Pack output generated at {docx_path}", "ok" if verified else "warning")

    return output, trace

"""Tests for pack student agent and checks."""

import json
import os
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from app.pack.checks import fact_mismatches, missing_sections
from app.pack.models import CompanyData, CompanyCase, REQUIRED_SECTIONS
from app.pack.student import PackConfig, run_pack_student, STRICT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, BASE_SYSTEM_PROMPT
from app.pack.tools import FixtureSource, ToolError, default_source
from app.llm import FakeLLMClient


class TestChecks:
    """Tests for fact-checking utilities."""

    def test_missing_sections_all_present(self):
        sections = {s: "content" for s in REQUIRED_SECTIONS}
        assert missing_sections(sections) == []

    def test_missing_sections_some_missing(self):
        sections = {"Overview": "text", "Key Facts": "text"}
        missing = missing_sections(sections)
        assert "Funding" in missing
        assert "Risks" in missing

    def test_missing_sections_blank(self):
        sections = {"Overview": "text", "Key Facts": "", "Funding": "text", "Risks": "text"}
        missing = missing_sections(sections)
        assert "Key Facts" in missing

    def test_fact_mismatches_employee_count_exact(self):
        company = CompanyData(
            name="Test", domain="test.com", industry="Tech", description="Test",
            employee_count=4000, founded_year=2020, hq_city="SF",
            total_funding_usd=1000000, last_round="Series A"
        )
        sections = {s: "content" for s in REQUIRED_SECTIONS}
        sections["Key Facts"] = "We have 4000 employees"
        assert "employee_count=4000 not stated exactly" not in fact_mismatches(company, sections)

    def test_fact_mismatches_employee_count_comma(self):
        company = CompanyData(
            name="Test", domain="test.com", industry="Tech", description="Test",
            employee_count=4000, founded_year=2020, hq_city="SF",
            total_funding_usd=1000000, last_round="Series A"
        )
        sections = {s: "content" for s in REQUIRED_SECTIONS}
        sections["Key Facts"] = "We have 4,000 employees"
        assert "employee_count=4000 not stated exactly" not in fact_mismatches(company, sections)

    def test_fact_mismatches_employee_count_rounded_fails(self):
        company = CompanyData(
            name="Test", domain="test.com", industry="Tech", description="Test",
            employee_count=2347, founded_year=2020, hq_city="SF",
            total_funding_usd=1000000, last_round="Series A"
        )
        sections = {s: "content" for s in REQUIRED_SECTIONS}
        sections["Key Facts"] = "We have about 2,000 employees"
        issues = fact_mismatches(company, sections)
        assert "employee_count=2347 not stated exactly" in issues

    def test_fact_mismatches_founded_year(self):
        company = CompanyData(
            name="Test", domain="test.com", industry="Tech", description="Test",
            employee_count=100, founded_year=2015, hq_city="SF",
            total_funding_usd=1000000, last_round="Series A"
        )
        sections = {s: "content" for s in REQUIRED_SECTIONS}
        sections["Overview"] = "Founded in 2015"
        assert "founded_year=2015 not stated exactly" not in fact_mismatches(company, sections)

        sections["Overview"] = "Founded recently"
        assert "founded_year=2015 not stated exactly" in fact_mismatches(company, sections)

    def test_fact_mismatches_hq_city(self):
        company = CompanyData(
            name="Test", domain="test.com", industry="Tech", description="Test",
            employee_count=100, founded_year=2015, hq_city="San Francisco",
            total_funding_usd=1000000, last_round="Series A"
        )
        sections = {s: "content" for s in REQUIRED_SECTIONS}
        sections["Overview"] = "Based in San Francisco"
        assert "hq_city=San Francisco not stated" not in fact_mismatches(company, sections)

    def test_fact_mismatches_last_round(self):
        company = CompanyData(
            name="Test", domain="test.com", industry="Tech", description="Test",
            employee_count=100, founded_year=2015, hq_city="SF",
            total_funding_usd=1000000, last_round="Series B"
        )
        sections = {s: "content" for s in REQUIRED_SECTIONS}
        sections["Funding"] = "Raised Series B funding"
        assert "last_round=Series B not stated" not in fact_mismatches(company, sections)

    def test_fact_mismatches_total_funding_exact(self):
        company = CompanyData(
            name="Test", domain="test.com", industry="Tech", description="Test",
            employee_count=100, founded_year=2015, hq_city="SF",
            total_funding_usd=42000000, last_round="Series B"
        )
        sections = {s: "content" for s in REQUIRED_SECTIONS}

            }

        assert output.tool_attempts == 1

        from docx import Document

                "Key Facts": "About 340 employees, founded around 2015, HQ in Pittsburgh area",
                "Funding": "Raised roughly $85M, last round Series B",
                "Risks": "Market competition"
            }
        })
        # Second response: exact numbers (should pass)
        good_response = json.dumps({
            "sections": {
                "Overview": "Apex Dynamics is a robotics company founded in 2015 in Pittsburgh.",
                "Key Facts": "342 employees, founded 2015, HQ Pittsburgh",
                "Funding": "Total funding $85,000,000, last round Series B",
                "Risks": "Competition in robotics market"
            }
        })

            return bad_response if call_count[0] == 1 else good_response

        fake_llm = FakeLLMClient(responder)
        config = PackConfig(output_dir=str(tmp_path), version="test", verify_facts=True)

        output, trace = run_pack_student(case_d01, config, llm=fake_llm)

+from collections import Counter
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+from app.models import FailureClass, ImprovementProposal, TraceEvent
+from app.observability import trace_span
+from app.pack.models import CompanyCase, PackOutput, REQUIRED_SECTIONS
+from app.pack.tools import FixtureSource, default_source
+from app.pack.checks import fact_mismatches, missing_sections
+from app.pack.student import run_pack_student, PackConfig
+from app.llm import FakeLLMClient, LLMClient, get_llm
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PackCaseResult:
+    case_id: str
+    split: str
+    success: bool
+    failure_class: FailureClass
+    issues: list[str]
+    tool_attempts: int
+    docx_path: str | None
+    trace: list[TraceEvent]
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PackSummary:
+    version: str
+    split: str
+    total: int
+    successes: int
+    success_rate: float
+    failure_counts: dict[str, int]
+    llm_calls: int
+    prompt_tokens: int
+    completion_tokens: int
+    retries: int
+    results: list[PackCaseResult]
+
+
+def evaluate_pack_case(
+    case: CompanyCase,
+    output: PackOutput,
+    trace: list[TraceEvent],
+    truth_source: FixtureSource,
+) -> PackCaseResult:
+    """Evaluate a single pack case output against ground truth."""
+    # Tool failures take precedence
+    has_tool_error = any(
+        getattr(event, "step", None) == "tool_execution"
+        and getattr(event, "outcome", None) == "error"
+        for event in trace
+    )
+
+    if has_tool_error:
+        failure_class: FailureClass = "tool_error"
+        issues = ["tool failed"]
+    else:
+        # Check for llm_parse error or missing docx -> invalid_output
+        has_llm_parse_error = any(
+            getattr(event, "step", None) == "llm_parse"
+            and getattr(event, "outcome", None) == "error"
+            for event in trace
+        )
+        if has_llm_parse_error or output.docx_path is None:
+            failure_class = "invalid_output"
+            issues = ["invalid llm output" if has_llm_parse_error else "no docx generated"]
+        else:
+            # Check missing sections
+            missing = missing_sections(output.sections)
+            if missing:
+                failure_class = "missing_section"
+                issues = missing
+            else:
+                # Check fact mismatches
+                truth = truth_source.get_company(case.domain)
+                fact_issues = fact_mismatches(truth, output.sections)
+                if fact_issues:
+                    failure_class = "wrong_fact"
+                    issues = fact_issues
+                else:
+                    failure_class = "none"
+                    issues = []
+
+    success = failure_class == "none"
+
+    return PackCaseResult(
+        case_id=case.case_id,
+        split=case.split,
+        success=success,
+        failure_class=failure_class,
+        issues=issues,
+        tool_attempts=output.tool_attempts,
+        docx_path=output.docx_path,
+        trace=trace,
+    )
+
+
+def run_pack_benchmark(
+    cases: list[CompanyCase],
+    config: PackConfig,
+    source: FixtureSource | None = None,
+    llm: FakeLLMClient | LLMClient | None = None,
+) -> PackSummary:
+    """Run pack benchmark over a list of cases."""
+    source = source or default_source()
+    # Use a plain FixtureSource for ground truth (never flaky)
+    truth_source = FixtureSource()
+    llm = llm or get_llm()
+
+    # Capture initial token counts
+    initial_calls = llm.calls
+    initial_prompt = llm.prompt_tokens
+    initial_completion = llm.completion_tokens
+
+    results = []
+    for case in cases:
+        with trace_span(
+            "benchmark_case",
+            kind="WORKFLOW",
+            attributes={
+                "benchmark.case_id": case.case_id,
+                "benchmark.split": case.split,
+                "agent.version": config.version,
+            },
+        ) as span:
+            output, trace = run_pack_student(case, config, source=source, llm=llm)
+            result = evaluate_pack_case(case, output, trace, truth_source)
+            span.set_attribute("evaluation.success", result.success)
+            span.set_attribute("evaluation.failure_class", result.failure_class)
+            results.append(result)
+
+    # Compute token deltas
+    llm_calls = llm.calls - initial_calls
+    prompt_tokens = llm.prompt_tokens - initial_prompt
+    completion_tokens = llm.completion_tokens - initial_completion
+    retries = sum(r.tool_attempts - 1 for r in results)
+
+    failure_counts = Counter(r.failure_class for r in results if not r.success)
+    total = len(results)
+    successes = sum(r.success for r in results)
+
+    return PackSummary(
+        version=config.version,
+        split=cases[0].split if cases else "empty",
+        total=total,
+        successes=successes,
+        success_rate=round(successes / total, 4) if total else 0.0,
+        failure_counts=dict(failure_counts),
+        llm_calls=llm_calls,
+        prompt_tokens=prompt_tokens,
+        completion_tokens=completion_tokens,
+        retries=retries,
+        results=results,
+    )

+from dataclasses import replace
+
+from app.models import ImprovementProposal, FailureClass
+from app.pack.evaluator import PackSummary
+from app.pack.student import PackConfig
+
+
+def propose_pack_improvements(summary: PackSummary) -> list[ImprovementProposal]:
+    """Generate improvement proposals from a pack benchmark summary."""
+    proposals = []
+    failures = summary.failure_counts
+    seen_keys = set()
+
+    # tool_error -> retry_tool_errors
+    if failures.get("tool_error", 0) > 0:
+        proposals.append(
+            ImprovementProposal(
+                target_failure="tool_error",
+                change_type="workflow_gate",
+                description="Enable retry for tool errors to handle transient upstream failures.",
+                config_key="retry_tool_errors",
+                config_value=True,
+            )
+        )
+        seen_keys.add("retry_tool_errors")
+
+    # wrong_fact -> strict_prompt AND verify_facts
+    if failures.get("wrong_fact", 0) > 0:
+        proposals.append(
+            ImprovementProposal(
+                target_failure="wrong_fact",
+                change_type="prompt_rule",
+                description="Use strict prompt that requires exact figures from data.",
+                config_key="strict_prompt",
+                config_value=True,
+            )
+        )
+        seen_keys.add("strict_prompt")
+
+        proposals.append(
+            ImprovementProposal(
+                target_failure="wrong_fact",
+                change_type="workflow_gate",
+                description="Enable fact verification to catch and fix hallucinated figures.",
+                config_key="verify_facts",
+                config_value=True,
+            )
+        )
+        seen_keys.add("verify_facts")
+
+    # missing_section -> verify_facts
+    if failures.get("missing_section", 0) > 0 and "verify_facts" not in seen_keys:
+        proposals.append(
+            ImprovementProposal(
+                target_failure="missing_section",
+                change_type="workflow_gate",
+                description="Enable fact verification to ensure all required sections are present.",
+                config_key="verify_facts",
+                config_value=True,
+            )
+        )
+        seen_keys.add("verify_facts")
+
+    # invalid_output alone proposes nothing
+    return proposals
+
+
+def apply_pack_proposals(config: PackConfig, proposals: list[ImprovementProposal]) -> PackConfig:
+    """Apply proposals to a config, returning a new candidate config."""
+    updated = replace(config)
+    for proposal in proposals:
+        if proposal.config_key == "retry_tool_errors":
+            updated.retry_tool_errors = bool(proposal.config_value)
+        elif proposal.config_key == "strict_prompt":
+            updated.strict_prompt = bool(proposal.config_value)
+        elif proposal.config_key == "verify_facts":
+            updated.verify_facts = bool(proposal.config_value)
+    updated.version = "candidate"
+    return updated
+
+
+# Reuse should_promote from app.improver
+from app.improver import should_promote

+from app.pack.benchmark import pack_cases_for_split
+from app.pack.evaluator import run_pack_benchmark
+from app.pack.improver import apply_pack_proposals, propose_pack_improvements, should_promote
+from app.pack.student import PackConfig
+from app.llm import get_llm
+
+
+def run_pack_improvement_cycle(llm=None):
+    """Run the pack improvement cycle."""
+    llm = llm or get_llm()
+
+    baseline_config = PackConfig(version="baseline", output_dir="outputs/baseline")
+    dev = pack_cases_for_split("development")
+    held = pack_cases_for_split("held_out")
+
+    # Baseline runs
+    bdev = run_pack_benchmark(dev, baseline_config, llm=llm)
+    bheld = run_pack_benchmark(held, baseline_config, llm=llm)
+
+    # Proposals from DEV only
+    proposals = propose_pack_improvements(bdev)
+
+    # Candidate config
+    candidate_config = apply_pack_proposals(baseline_config, proposals)
+    candidate_config.output_dir = "outputs/candidate"
+
+    # Candidate runs
+    cdev = run_pack_benchmark(dev, candidate_config, llm=llm)
+    cheld = run_pack_benchmark(held, candidate_config, llm=llm)
+
+    promoted, reasons = should_promote(bdev, cdev, bheld, cheld)
+
+    # Build cost dict
+    def cost_dict(summary):
+        return {
+            "llm_calls": summary.llm_calls,
+            "prompt_tokens": summary.prompt_tokens,
+            "completion_tokens": summary.completion_tokens,
+        }
+
+    return {
+        "baseline": {
+            "development": bdev.__dict__,
+            "held_out": bheld.__dict__,
+        },
+        "proposals": [p.model_dump() for p in proposals],
+        "candidate": {
+            "development": cdev.__dict__,
+            "held_out": cheld.__dict__,
+        },
+        "promotion": {"promoted": promoted, "reasons": reasons},
+        "active_version": candidate_config.version if promoted else baseline_config.version,
+        "cost": {
+            "baseline": cost_dict(bdev),
+            "candidate": cost_dict(cdev),
+        },
+        "note": "LLM-backed pack agent; results are measured on a small synthetic fixture set.",
+    }
